quote: A new automatic paraphrasing model, based on BART, that can generate natural paraphrases of sentences

We obtain paraphrases for the generated sentences using a neural paraphraser based on the BART sequence-to-sequence model... The paraphraser can generate phrases like "people with a Stanford degree" ... These paraphrases are used to train the semantic parser.

AutoQA first generates short example sentences for each attribute using its canonical annotation... obtains paraphrases for the generated sentences using a neural paraphraser based on the BART sequence-to-sequence model
Our evaluation metric is logical form accuracy: the logical form produced by our parser must exactly match the one in the test set.
We compare the diversity of the two datasets using distinct-1 and distinct-2 metrics which measure the ratio of distinct unigram and bigrams in the datasets.
